strings.zh: 删除的存档无法再恢复。{CLEAR}另外口袋计步器上{CLEAR}登录的信息也将删除。{SCROLL}确认删除吗？
strings.en: Once data has been deleted,{NEWLINE}there is no way to recover it.{SCROLL}Furthermore, Pokéwalker registered{NEWLINE}data will also be erased.{SCROLL}Delete the saved data anyway?
